summary: Backend (13/13 pytest passing including LLM-backed routines/generate via Claude Sonnet 4.5 and skin/analyze via Gemini 2.5 Pro) and frontend (login → home → tabs flow) tested successfully. Demo user auth, JWT bearer, profile CRUD, routines generation+retrieval, tracking toggle/today/stats, journal CRUD, seasonal tips, and skin analysis all work. Frontend Expo web preview loads, demo login auto-fills and navigates to /home, all 4 tabs (Accueil, Routines, Journal, Profil) render correctly with proper French copy and Organic & Earthy aesthetic (sage green / warm sand). Routine steps display with benefits, Profil shows skin profile + seasonal tips + logout, Journal shows empty state with + FAB.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - cosmetic only, comes from RN Web; non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: add explicit testID props on login screen (demo-button, login-button, email-input, password-input), routines tab buttons (matin/soir/hebdo + regenerate), and journal FAB to make automated regression testing more robust. All flows currently work via French text matching.
Note: demo user got profile + routines populated by backend tests; if you want a fresh demo experience, reset demo user's skin_profile to null between test runs (so onboarding flow is exercised).

Onboarding 5-step flow was NOT exercised end-to-end via UI in this run because the demo user already had a profile (from pytest). Backend signup → no-profile path was verified (returns 400 from /routines/generate without profile).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines and still cohesive but starting to grow; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, profile.py, routines.py, journal.py, tracking.py) once it crosses ~700 lines.
/api/skin/analyze: tiny 1x1 PNG returned 200 with skin_type='indéterminé' — handled gracefully; good fallback.
JWT secret falls back to 'dev-secret' if JWT_SECRET env not set — fine for preview but ensure prod sets it.
seed_data_creation: Demo user (demo@skincare.app) now has a saved skin_profile (mixte, 26-35, eclat+deshydratation) and 3 routines (matin/soir/hebdo) generated by Claude Sonnet 4.5 during pytest. Several TEST_*@example.com signup users created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://skin-match-7.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo creds work. Demo user already has profile/routines so login lands on /home directly; to test onboarding wipe demo user's skin_profile in mongo first. LLM calls take 15-30s; pytest-timeout=90s used for /routines/generate.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All requested features verified working end-to-end.
